# Project Overview

Personal website displaying a CV: skills, experience and projects. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui (Base UI primitives).

## Folder Structure

- `cv.yaml`: All CV content (single source of truth, also read by Typst). Dates `YYYY-MM`, omit `end` if ongoing. `basics.url` is the canonical URL.
- `src/data.ts`: TypeScript types; re-exports `cv.yaml` (via `@rollup/plugin-yaml`).
- `src/App.tsx`: Page sections.
- `src/entry-server.tsx`: `render()` (app HTML) and `head()` (meta, Open Graph, JSON-LD from `cv.yaml`) for prerendering.
- `vite.config.ts`: `prerender` plugin injects both into `index.html` (`<!--head-->`). `src/main.tsx` hydrates it.
- `src/components/ui`: shadcn components. Add new ones with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <name>`.
- `src/index.css`: Theme tokens (slate chalkboard palette, glass glow, `chalk` utility).

## Coding Standards

- Use semantic colors (`primary`, `muted-foreground`, …) instead of hard-coded colors.
- Use shadcn components before custom markup.
- Run `pnpm run format` and `pnpm run lint` before committing.
- Keep render deterministic (prerendered and hydrated): no `window`, `Date.now()` or randomness in render; put browser-only work in `useEffect`.
- Always clean up unused code and styles.

## UI guidelines

- Futuristic chalkboard: slate background, frosted glass panels with a cool glowing rim, and chalk lettering (`chalk` utility, Architects Daughter) written on them. Never put `chalk` on an ancestor of a glass surface (CSS filter breaks backdrop blur).
- Use subtle animations for visual feedback; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
